meta.name: video-summarizer
meta.description: Analyzes local MP4 video files using the Gemini API and generates structured Markdown summaries. Supports custom prompts to extract specific information instead of the default summary. Use when the user wants to summarize, analyze, or extract key points from video files in bulk. Triggers on requests like "summarize my videos", "create markdown summaries for the videos", "analyze videos with Gemini", "generate video summaries", or "extract X from my videos". Requires GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable set in the system.
